statement: ∀ (q : ℕ) (u : ℝ), 1≤q → 4≤u → let T := Real.sqrt u; 2≤T ∧ T≤u ∧ u*Real.log ((q : ℝ)*u*T)^2/T ≤ 4*Real.sqrt u*Real.log ((q : ℝ)*u)^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0007 · Budget the explicit-formula error at square-root height

brief.zh: 在固定公式的第一项代入 T=√u。低零点项保留在零点预算里。
brief.en: Insert T=√u in the height-dependent error. Account separately for the low zeros.
